Job Title: Storekeeper 
Location: Rotterdam, Netherlands 
Salary: €33,000-€35,000 gross per year 
Languages: Dutch (B1) & English 
We are seeking a Hotel Storekeeper to join our hospitality team. 
The hotel delivers exceptional guest experiences, and the storekeeper role is crucial for maintaining seamless operations through efficient inventory and supply management. 
This position requires strong organizational abilities, meticulous attention to detail, and the capacity to maintain optimal stock levels while supporting all hotel departments with their supply needs. 
Key Responsibilities 
Manage and control inventory of all hotel supplies and equipment 
Coordinate with suppliers, place orders, and verify deliveries 
Conduct regular stock audits and reconcile inventory discrepancies 
Ensure proper storage, organization, and rotation of all items 
Distribute supplies to departments according to requirements 
Monitor stock levels and anticipate demand to prevent shortages 
Maintain accurate records, documentation, and reporting 
Implement cost-control measures and minimize waste 
Candidate Profile 
Previous experience as a storekeeper, preferably in hospitality 
Strong organizational and inventory management skills 
Familiarity with stock control systems and inventory software 
Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced environment 
Basic computer literacy for inventory tracking 
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities 
Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy 
Fluency in English and Dutch (at least B1).
